display_name: Tri 无标签相位一致性互补分支三种子消融
description: Two matched three-seed Tri SSL continuations apply bounded common-phase U consistency to frequency+PA or to time+path+reference; all other phase, U and training settings fixed.
authorization: User requests Tri-SIG-TIME-based multi-branch SSL research, three paired seeds, practical seven scenes and GPU 0-4 on N607.

code.environment: N607 existing Phase1 Python; FP32 TF32 off; 2 CPU threads

data.contract_ref: existing unchanged VALIDATED_ONCE Main split source/received IQ handles
data.physical_ids_ref: Main split source role index and cross_rx/cross_both manifests

roles.U_s: 56700 source IQ with TX labels hidden

data.leo_config_ref: clean plus six practical scenes only; no leo_weak

permissions.claim_scope: Phase1 terrestrial proxy; direct recognition; no future-date or in-orbit claim

checkpoint.initialization: same-seed Tri-SIG-TIME source-only scratch E20; continue E10+E20
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: same F0 source contract; no target or U truth use
checkpoint.selection_rule: fixed final E50, no target feedback

execution.gpu_policy: All N607 GPUs 0-7 allowed; at most two observed or pending processes/card, free-memory admission, preserve other owners
execution.stop_rule: Systemic technical failure stops new dispatch; retain healthy workers and output; no target-driven decisions

expected_artifacts: six E50 models and phase-U exposures
six seven-scene truth-blind prediction sets before independent scores
paired branch subset, full phase, Tri and PL scene and TX/RX/day analysis

notes: The two subsets are complementary; each branch mean is normalized within its subset, so changing subset changes which and how many terms receive the fixed weight.

Bounded phase and all REPL settings match the earlier full-phase candidate; the new ablation was conceived after that previously exposed Main split result and is developmental, not an independent blind test.
No target-truth or U-truth training; fixed E50 before target predictions; no target-driven checkpoint selection or rerun.
DURA-LU primary; raw and DURA-L secondary; cross_rx plus cross_both main and cross_date diagnostic; no leo_weak.
